title: 電気エネルギー発生工学
subtitle: Electric Power Generation
keywords: Thermal power plant 2.Nuclear power plant 3.Renewable energy 4.Hydro power plant 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will (1) learn the working principle and systems of a thermal power plant (2) learn the working principle and systems of a nuclear power plant (3) learn the various renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, geothermal and fuel cell. (3) learn the working principle and systems of a hydro power plant
advice: Course Description 1. Outline (the demand for electrical energy) 2. Thermal power plant 2.1 Principle, basic fundamentals of thermodynamics 2.2 Facilities 2.3 Gas turbine and combined cycle power plant 3. Nuclear power plant 3.1 Principle, basic fundamentals of nuclear fission 3.2 Facilities and reactor types 3.3 Basics safety principles 3.4 Plutonium use in a thermal reactor, nuclear fuel cycle, and nuclear waste treatment 4. Renewable energy 4.1 Solar power 4.2 Wind power 4.3 Geothermal power plant 4.4 Fuel cell 5. Hydro power plant 5.1 Principle, basic fundamentals for hydraulics 5.2 Facilities 5.3 Output and efficiency calculation Expectations for Students To understand the lecture well, basic knowledge about physics such as thermodynamics, hydraulics etc. is required.
books: Textbook: Power plant and substation (Revised edition), ISBN: 9784886862235 (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: This course is strongly related with the following courses: ‘electrical machine I’, ‘Transmission and distribution of electrical energy’. It’s necessary to review the basic knowledge obtained from those related courses in advance.

activityGoals.body: To be able to calculate energy efficiency for various thermal power plants and to explain various devices
To be able to explain basic principle of nuclear power plant, systems, safety, fuel cycle and waste treatment
To be able to explain principles and features of solar power, wind power, geothermal and fuel cell
To be able to calculate energy efficiency for various hydro power plants and to explain various devices

lessons.content: [Guidance] *Explanation of syllabus [Introduction of the generation of electrical energy] *The demand for electrical energy
lessons.assignments: * To understand the necessity of studying this course

lessons.content: [Thermal power plant 1] *Working principle of thermal power plant *Basic fundamentals of thermodynamics
lessons.assignments: *To understand working principle and thermodynamics (enthalpy, entropy, energy conservations law, adiabatic process)

lessons.content: [Thermal power plant 2] *Regenerative Rankine cycle with reheat *Facilities (boiler, turbine, generator, environmental protection devices)
lessons.assignments: *To understand T-s diagram for regenerative Rankine cycle with reheat and facilities

lessons.content: [Thermal power plant 3] *Gas turbine *Gas turbine combined cycle *Energy efficiency calculation
lessons.assignments: *To understand gas turbine combined cycle and energy efficiency calculation
To review the contents of the lecture 2 to 4

lessons.content: [Nuclear power plant 1] *Working principle of nuclear power plant
lessons.assignments: *To understand working principle of nuclear power plant

lessons.content: [Nuclear power plant 2] *Component (nuclear fuel, coolant, neutron absorbing material, reactor pressure vessel etc.) *BWR, PWR, ABWR, APWR
lessons.assignments: *To understand component and features of reactor types

lessons.content: [Nuclear power plant 3] *Nuclear fuel cycle and waste treatment *Basics safety principles [Renewable energy 1] *Solar power and wind power
lessons.assignments: *To understand nuclear fuel cycle and waste treatment *To understand features of solar power and wind power

lessons.content: [Renewable energy 2] *Geothermal power plant and fuel cell (PAFC, PEFC, MCFC, SOFC)
lessons.assignments: *To understand features of geothermal power plant and fuel cell
To review the contents of the lecture 6 to 9

lessons.content: [Hydro power plant 1] *Working principle of hydro power plant *basic fundamentals of hydraulics and electrical power output calculation based on gravitational potential energy law
lessons.assignments: *To understand working principle, hydraulics (law of continuity, Bernoulli’s principle) and electrical power output calculation

lessons.content: [Hydro power plant 2] *Input energy calculation for pumped storage hydropower *Rated rotational speed of hydro turbine
lessons.assignments: *To understand input power calculation for pumped storage hydro power

lessons.content: [Hydro power plant 3] *Facilities (dam, penstock, tank, hydro turbine, generator etc.)

lessons.assignments: *To review the contents of the lecture 11 to 13

lessons.content: [Auxiliary and reflection class] *Questionnaire of the lecture [Self-check] *Notice of evaluation results
